`lhs` has dims `("x", "y")` with shape `(2, 3)`, and `rhs` has dims `("z", "y")` with shape `(4, 3)`. With `input_core_dims=[["y"], ["y"]]` and `output_core_dims=[["y"]]`, `apply_ufunc` treats `y` as the shared core dimension and broadcasts the remaining non-core dimensions `x` and `z`, so the result keeps `y` of length 3 and combines the broadcast dimensions into shape `(2, 4, 3)`. The test also explicitly checks `list(out.data.shape) == [2, 4, 3]`.

## Answer
{"data_shape":[2,4,3]}
